notes.title: Developer Update: Patch 0.2.9 - What's Next for The Dark World
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/a68798e23ae2c7b634ab202cd15b6571574fd402.jpg
Dear players,

We want to take a moment to address an important update regarding the development of The Dark World: Edge of Eternity. Unfortunately, we are unable to deliver Patch 0.2.9 on the originally scheduled date of January 15, 2025.

The transition from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5 has proven to be more challenging than anticipated. As a solo developer, these hurdles have required extra time and care to ensure the game maintains the quality you expect and deserve. I sincerely apologize for the delay and kindly ask for your understanding as we work to bring you the best possible experience.

That being said, we’re excited to announce that Patch 0.9.0 will now be released on February 15, 2025. Following this patch, we plan to roll out a series of updates with bug fixes and new content to lay the groundwork for Patch 0.3.0, which will introduce the highly anticipated new race: vampires.

With Patch 0.2.9, we’re introducing exciting updates and improvements to The Dark World: Edge of Eternity that will not only enhance the gameplay experience but also set the stage for future content and features. Here's what’s coming:


 New Optimized World (64 Square Kilometers)
- The game world has been expanded and optimized, providing a massive 64 sq. km area to explore, filled with mysteries, challenges, and opportunities.

 Territories: Human, Vampire, and Werewolf
- The map now includes distinct territories for Humans, Vampires, and Werewolves, each with its own atmosphere, challenges, and lore.

 Improved Questing with Level Restrictions
- Questing now features level restrictions to ensure balanced progression. This change will also support group questing mechanics planned for Patch 0.3.0.

 Vehicles and Vehicle Mechanics
- Vehicles have been added, complete with shooting mechanics. Expect smoother handling, refueling mechanics, vehicle repairs (including flat tires), and an inventory system for vehicles, all of which will be further refined in future updates.

 Improved NPCs
- NPCs have been upgraded with a new brain component that makes them tougher based on their level. They can now attack in groups, offering a more dynamic and challenging combat experience.

 Magic Temporarily Removed
- Magic has been disabled for now to align with the introduction of Witches as a playable character class in Patch 0.9.0.

 Zones with Unique Weather Patterns
- Human Zones: Normal weather changes.
- Werewolf Zones: Foggy and atmospheric.
- Vampire Zones: Extreme cold with heavy snow and low visibility for an added challenge.

 First-Person View
- Players can now switch to a first-person perspective, adding a new layer of immersion to the gameplay.

 Weapons and Weapon Handling Improvements
- Weapon mechanics have been overhauled, with sniper scopes added, as well as a new menu for swapping weapon attachments.

 Simplified Gameplay with a Focus on Combat
- Gameplay has been streamlined, putting a stronger emphasis on combat mechanics to deliver a more engaging and action-packed experience.

 Simplified Looting
- The looting system has been simplified. You no longer need to chop trees or collect resources manually, making gameplay more streamlined and action-focused.

 Emotes Introduced
- Emotes have been added to enhance player interaction. Currently, only one emote is available, but we will expand this system in future updates.

 Server Settings and Admin Tools
- Host players (and future dedicated server owners) now have access to server settings and admin menu tools to better manage their game sessions.

 Random Map Missions
- Random map missions have been implemented to encourage PvP engagements and bring more dynamic gameplay moments.

 Cross-Play Support
- Cross-play is now enabled between players using Steam and Epic Games Launcher, ensuring a larger and more connected community.

 And Many More...
- There are additional tweaks and improvements not listed here

Your continued support and patience mean the world to us as we navigate these challenges and push the boundaries of what The Dark World: Edge of Eternity can be.

Early Access Warning
   The Dark World: Edge of Eternity is currently in Early Access. As an evolving project, features, mechanics, and content are subject to change based on player feedback and ongoing development.

While we strive to deliver the best possible experience, please keep in mind:

- Some systems may not be fully polished and are still being actively worked on.
- Bugs and performance issues may occur, and we are continuously working on improvements.
- Content, such as quests, mechanics, and world-building, may be rebalanced or adjusted as we fine-tune the game for its full release.

   We encourage you to share your thoughts, feedback, and bug reports with us through Steam discussions or our official channels. Your support and input play a vital role in shaping the future of The Dark World: Edge of Eternity.

   Thank you for embarking on this journey with us, and we can’t wait to see what the community helps us build!

Warm regards,
Jericho
Digital Gods

notes.title: State of Game #6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/ee699c926424d863e91800daa578dba5d7a20f85.jpg
We are continuing to improve the game experience with significant updates and new features. Item rarity and durability systems have been reworked to enhance gameplay strategy. Players can now use throwables, engage in knives/daggers combat, and utilize throwing knives/daggers for stealth attacks. Explosives, including sticky bombs, contact explosives, and regular explosives, have been added for more dynamic combat. Craftable traps provide new tactical options, and exclusive content for backers has been introduced as a token of appreciation for their support.


     Reworked Item Rarity
     Item State/Durability Reworked
     Added Throwables
     Added Knifes/Dagers Combat
     Added Throwing Knifes/dagers
     Added Explosives (sticky, on contact, regular)
     Added Craftable Traps
     Backers Content


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/894466a61c4c303fc20c0c17954b7b4893b08908.jpg

The updated item interface displays crucial information about each item’s state and category. Items can now be in one of five states: Pristine, Worn, Damaged, Badly Damaged, or Ruined, affecting their performance and usability. The interface also shows if an item can be used in the hotbar for quick access during gameplay. Each item is categorized clearly, such as resources, build kits, and tools, helping players manage their inventory effectively. For example, the Stone is a resource, the Building Plan is a build kit, and the Metal Hatchet is a tool, each with specific uses and durability levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/bbc1d9bba565d5ee25bb29e2d764037790bbdb9a.jpg

Backer Content Access:

Everyone who pledged in our crowdfunding campaign can claim Backer role through a private message on our Discord by sending the email address used on the crowdfunding platform from (FundRazr, CrowdFundr, Ko-Fi, Patreon).

Behind the scenes content will be unlocked on Discord after verification.

Planned Game Content:

We have completed the full roadmap for our game and will be releasing it in the coming days, available for all players. For our backers, we have more detailed content, including plans for expansions, dungeons, raids, bosses, and more. This roadmap will outline all the exciting planned content and features that will enhance your gaming experience. Stay tuned for more updates and details on what’s coming next!

 

We look forward to you enjoying these new contents and upgrades, and we thank you for your support as we continue to develop our game.

See you in game, The Digital Gods Team

notes.title: State of Game #5
notes.content:
This patch brings significant enhancements to the user interface, including a major redesign of the skill page and the introduction of the “Player Card” to better organize the Player Inventory. The game world has been updated with new traps and puzzles at points of interest, a redesigned Witchfire Glade, and direct access to dungeon and raid entrances without the need for teleportation. Networking improvements feature better server-client interaction, fixes for connectivity issues, and an anti-cheat system. Additionally, the in-game admin tools for server owners have been upgraded with enhanced player management, quick access commands, custom spawn tools, and new teleport options, making server management more efficient and user-friendly.

UI Improvements:

We will start with user interface improvements. Enhancing UI readability is a very important task to ensure you don’t get lost in all the information on your screen. To make navigating through the UI more comfortable, we have made significant changes. It is still a work in progress, so bear with us. The skill page has undergone a major redesign, which is essential before we introduce the vampire race. Keep in mind that this is just an early bird version, and the overall look can change during early access.

We have moved many elements from the Player Inventory to a new page called “Player Card”.

We are also working on enhancing the in-game admin tools for server owners. These tools are currently a work in progress, but we are committed to making server management more efficient and user-friendly. Here are some of the key updates and features you can expect:


 Enhanced Player Management: Controls for managing players directly in-game.

notes.title: State of Game #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/23a6a25209a2014fe3b9df289257720f8ea9d333.jpg
Introducing the latest update, “State of Game #2,” for “The Dark World”! While this version is still in development, we’re excited to share our progress as we transition the game from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5. This update focuses on laying the groundwork for enhanced visuals and performance, with dynamic foliage interactions, revamped NPC and event spawners, and the implementation of Discord Rich Presence for seamless community integration. Stay tuned as we prepare to unveil these exciting enhancements, including revamped designs for the game introduction and main menu, bringing us closer to an even more immersive gaming experience.

UE4 (Legacy)
No Changes

UE5 (W.I.P) build:0.2.9.000

Visual Improvements:
This is an example of how a new approach provides us with new possibilities to enhance visuals and performance, even as the game logic expands. Foliage now reacts to wind and interacts with the player with sound and/or movement as they walk through it, creating a more immersive look and feel when you are playing the game.

OLD: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/a197c14880d5385fa82b589ce279f10b052aeb1d.jpg

NEW:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/887f50913ea5d22a15778a8f8ad5be33ccd3d344.jpg


NPC & Event Spawner Overhaul:
We’ve revamped all spawners for NPCs. NPC entities are no longer loaded in memory all the time, as was the case in the Legacy version, which caused low performance. The new spawners now utilize player proximity, time of day, moon phase, and weather conditions for spawning, resulting in improved performance. With these new spawners, we can now have over 5000 NPC spawns with minimal impact on performance.

Here’s how the new spawns work for different types of NPCs:
– Human NPC spawns only during the Day
– Vampire NPC spawns only at Night
– Werewolf NPC spawn only during a Full Moon
– Witch NPC spawn only when there is Fog outside

World Event Spawners for Airdrop, Helicopter Crash, and Missions use a random timer (e.g., the Helicopter Crash spawns once during the day and once during the night)

Dynamic Visual & Audio Player Warnings during gameplay
– Audio: Air raid sirens sound warning players in cities one in-game hour before sunset.
– Visual: Dynamic visual warnings during gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/aa711cf9c59ef3511c2f5d0816dba2c32e1aea7e.jpg

Discord Rich Presence:
We’ve implemented Discord Rich Presence functionality, which means that now, when you’re playing “The Dark World”, your Discord profile will display your current in-game activity. This feature enhances the gaming experience by allowing you to share your progress and engagement with friends and the wider gaming community directly through Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/25f05fb8cde3ffe2ef8066323455405bc8094262.png

New Digital Gods Login & Inventory System:
Take a glimpse at the revamped designs for the game introduction and main menu, showcasing enhanced visuals and improved user interface elements.
[previewyoutube=9uWJKsFuqCU;full][/previewyoutube]

We look forward to you enjoying these new contents and upgrades, and we thank you for your support as we continue to develop our game.

    Death is but the doorway to new Life

See you in game, The Digital Gods Dev Team

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8.272
notes.content:
In this latest update (UE4 – Legacy), we’ve fine-tuned Buff & Debuff stats on items and bid farewell to the Christmas Event. Several optimizations were made to enhance the overall gaming experience, including tweaks to the crafting recipes of “Hi-Tech Workshop” and “Wooden Beam,” as well as fixing the item weight and sell price for “Empty Can.” Our attention to detail extends to fixing building collisions at Osijek – East Location and resolving issues with weight updates after reaching maximum inventory weight. Thanks to the valuable input from InuYasha, we’ve addressed crafting recipe discrepancies and potential fixes for Hotbar items. Additionally, we’ve removed the Load Game option from the multiplayer pause menu, as it is intended for singleplayer use only.

Looking ahead to UE5 (Work in Progress), exciting additions include new building models designed for more dynamic gunfights, doors opening away from players to ensure smoother movement within buildings, and the introduction of breakable glass mechanics that react to various damage sources. The DG Launcher features, encompassing login, player inventory, shop functionality, and player profiles, are also in the pipeline.

UE4 – Legacy

   - Buff & Debuff stats tweaks on items
   - Removed Christmas Event
   - World optimization tweaks
   - Fixed crafting recipe for “Hi-Tech Workshop” (Thanks to InuYasha)
   - Fixed crafting recipe for “Wooden Beam” (Thanks to InuYasha)
   - Fixed item weight and sell price for “Empty Can”
   - Fixed building collision at Osijek – East Location (Thanks to InuYasha)
   - Fixed weight update after reaching maximum inventory weight (Thanks to InuYasha)
   - Possible Fix for Hotbar items not calculating proper damage and durability (Thanks to InuYasha)
   - Removed Load Game from multiplayer pause menu (It is used for singleplayer only) (Thanks to InuYasha)

UE5 (W.I.P)

NEW:

   - New buildings models (designed for third person for more fluid gunfight)
   - Opening Doors away from player (more fluid movement trough buildings and prevents player to stuck between door and wall)
   - Breakable Glass (glass react/break on any damage, etc. projectile, explosion, spells or jump trough window)
   - DG Launcher features implementation (login, player inventory, shop, player profile)

LIST OF ALL NEW FEATURES IMPLEMENTED SO FAR:

    - Digital Gods Standalone Launcher
    - New World map and Minimap (high quality map, fog of war, player markers and notes, map grid, landmarks and many more).
    - Player Movement (Locomotion, Vaulting, Climbing…)

We look forward to you enjoying these new contents and upgrades, and we thank you for your support as we continue to develop our game.

    Death is but the doorway to new Life

See you in game, The Digital Gods Dev Team

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8.245
notes.content:
Dear Guardians,

In the spirit of gratitude for your continued support, we come bearing even more exciting news! While we diligently work on upgrading to Unreal Engine 5 to elevate your gaming experience in Panonia, we've decided to make this journey even more accessible for everyone.

We've lowered the price of the game until the release of the Unreal Engine 5 version. This is your golden opportunity to seize your copy at a more affordable rate and embark on the adventure that awaits within the treacherous territories of Panonia.

Your support means the world to us, and we want as many players as possible to join us on this epic quest. So, don your armor, sharpen your blades, and venture forth into a world where destiny unfolds amidst power, vengeance, and survival.

Now, a piece of the new legacy update has been unveiled. As we immerse ourselves in the realms of Panonia, let's take a moment to delve into the latest improvements and fixes that come with the Unreal Engine 4 version.

Here are the patch notes:

This patch introduces several new settings, including mouse sensitivity and invert options, alongside fixes for UI issues and improvements to game optimization. Additionally, it adds a "Report Bug" button, main menu warnings for external links, and a festive Christmas event. The update also includes visual fixes for companions and optimizations for world loading speed.

Legacy Unreal Engine 4 Version:

- added Mouse Sensitivity Setting
- added Invert Mouse Horizontal & Vertical Setting
- Fixed Pause Menu
- Fixed UI not showing correct build
- Fixed UI Elements Overlap on some screen resolutions
- Fixed Inventory UI leak out off screen on certain resolutions
- Added "Report BUG" button in game
- Added Main menu warnings when opening external links
- Optimization tweaks related to NPC's
- Fixed Companion visuals
- Added Christmas Event
- Optimization tweaks related to world loading speed

Unreal Engine 5 (W.I.P)

First and foremost, we're in the process of transitioning the game to our dedicated launcher, and as part of this move, we'll be discontinuing its availability on Steam following the engine upgrade. The rationale behind this decision is simple – we aim to offer you our games at more affordable prices. This strategic shift allows us to optimize costs and pass on the savings directly to you. Thank you for your understanding and continued support as we strive to make our gaming experience even more accessible.

Prepare to be amazed by the latest additions in our upcoming version! Here's a sneak peek at some of the exciting new features:
- Digital Gods Game Launcher
- New World map and Minimap (High quality Map, Fog of war, Player markers and notes, Map grid, Landmarks and many more).
- Player Movement (Locomotion, Vaulting, Climbing...)




We look forward to you enjoying these new contents and upgrades, and we thank you for your support as we continue to develop our game.

Death is but the doorway to new Life

See you in game, The Digital Gods Dev Team

notes.title: Into the Dark - Patch 0.2.8.227
notes.content:
Dive into the enhanced world of Panonia with this Patch! We've spiced up character classes, bid farewell to the Halloween spooks, and introduced cool features like Night Vision Goggles. The Human Zone got a facelift too—no more Vampires or Werewolves hassling you, just a peaceful life behind concrete walls.

Oh, and did we mention usable buffs? Spice up your gameplay with strategic power-ups for specific durations. Enjoy a sleeker interface and other tweaks for a smoother ride.

Join us on this Panonian adventure—your feedback makes it all the more epic. Let the gaming begin!

Character Class and Talents:

Introduction of Starting Gear and Stats: Character classes now come with unique starting gear and stats to provide a more immersive gameplay experience.
Race and Class-Based Talents: We've laid the foundation for talents specific to each race and class, adding depth and strategy for the future character development.

Event Changes:

Halloween Event Removal: The Halloween event has been removed from the game.
Achievement Adjustments: Achievements tied to the Halloween event have also been removed.

New Items and Crafting:

Night Vision Goggles (NVG): NVGs are now available and can be acquired from the Nisha trader or crafted using a specific recipe.
Improved Character Customization: Enhancements have been made to the character customization interface for a more user-friendly experience.
Bow Fix: The issue where the bow could get stuck has been resolved, ensuring smoother gameplay.

World Changes:

Vampire and Werewolf Adjustments: Vampire and Werewolf spawns have been removed from the Human Zone (Sector A), altering the dynamic of encounters within this area. Now, if you don't want to engage with the horrors of Panonia, you can enjoy a peaceful life inside the walls.
Human Zone Rework: The Human Zone (Sector A) now features a diverse range of NPC spawns, including the Human Friendly Army, Traders, and various Animals.
Concrete Wall Construction: A concrete wall is now under construction around the Human Zone (Sector A), providing a safety and rest from your day of hunting.

Item Tweaks:

Item Adjustments: Various tweaks have been made to certain items, optimizing their functionality and balance.

New Feature - Usable Buffs:

Temporary Buffs: A new feature allows players to use buffs for specific durations (half an hour, one hour, two hours, and six hours). These buffs enhance character stats and can be strategically employed during gameplay.

User Interface Tweaks:

UI Enhancements: Several tweaks have been made to the user interface, improving overall usability and visual appeal.

These comprehensive changes aim to enrich the gaming experience, offering a more diverse and engaging environment within the realms of Panonia. We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we strive to enhance and expand the game. Enjoy your adventures in the ever-evolving world of Panonia!

"Death is but the doorway to new Life"

See you in game, The Digital Gods Dev Team

notes.title: Unleashing Magic and Innovations
notes.content:
The most recent update to the game brings significant enhancements and new features. Two new traders, Nisha and Azriel, have been introduced, expanding the in-game economy. Players can now expect smoother interactions with companions, as issues with companion dialogue have been addressed.

The user interface has undergone a substantial overhaul, improving the overall gaming experience. Item tooltips now provide information on item values, aiding players in making informed decisions. In terms of optimization, there have been notable improvements, with GPU usage reduced by half, leading to better performance on a variety of systems.

In the world-building aspect, the addition of electricity in houses and buildings enhances the immersive quality of the game. Crafting enthusiasts will appreciate the new blueprints for light switches and lights for base building, expanding creative possibilities.

Exploration has become even more captivating with the inclusion of a train rail in the human zone, and players can now make use of trains for transportation. Elevators within buildings make navigating them more convenient.

The introduction of a skill tree that unlocks magic abilities adds a new dimension to character progression. Magic abilities, alongside item buffs, offer fresh gameplay experiences.

The inventory user interface has seen changes to enhance usability, and NPCs have become more rewarding, now dropping coins as loot. Learnable recipes have been added, and lab desk and grinder recipes have been updated for crafting enthusiasts.

Several bug fixes are in place, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience. For those in the Halloween spirit, an exciting Halloween event has been added to celebrate the season. All in all, this patch brings a multitude of improvements, additions, and fixes, enhancing the game's depth and engagement.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.8.056
notes.content:
In this patch, we’ve dedicated ourselves to enhancing the gameplay experience in “The Dark World: Edge of Eternity.” We’ve diligently addressed a range of issues, beginning with ensuring proper NPC spawns. The addition of a formidable Werewolf World Boss, Fenris “The Unleashed,” promises an exciting new challenge for players.

To ensure a balanced and engaging combat environment, we’ve meticulously corrected damage values and multipliers for all weapons. Our goal is to provide you with a satisfying and immersive combat experience.

Diving deeper into the realm of challenge, we’ve elevated the lethality of Vampire and Werewolf NPCs, making encounters with these formidable foes even more intense.

User experience has also been a focus. We’ve addressed the absence of hotbar icons, resulting in smoother and more intuitive gameplay.

Loot mechanics have undergone fine-tuning and fixes, promising a more rewarding and captivating gameplay loop for all adventurers.

Additionally, we’ve undertaken a comprehensive redesign of the Osijek safezone, offering a fresh and immersive environment. A new location, Osijek – West, invites exploration and discovery, expanding the world for you to immerse yourself in.

Our commitment to enhancing the User Interface is evident in minor yet impactful alterations. Navigation and engagement within the game have been made even more intuitive.

Further enhancing your journey, the InGame Map has undergone refinements and now functions correctly. Introducing new map markers, we’ve aimed to facilitate navigation and encourage discovery.

Acknowledging the importance of performance, we’ve implemented optimization tweaks. These refinements ensure a smoother performance, contributing to an uninterrupted and immersive gaming experience.

Changes:

– Fixed NPC Spawns
– Added Werewolf World Boss (Fenris “The Unleashed”)
– Corrected damage values and damage multipliers on all weapons
– Enhanced lethality of Vampire and Werewolf NPC’s
– Included missing hotbar icons
– Adjustments made to loot and fixes
– Redesigned Osijek safezone
– Introduced a new location (Osijek – West)
– Minor alterations related to User Interface
– Slightly improved and now functioning correctly InGame Map
– Added new map markers
– Optimization tweaks for smoother performance

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. As you continue your journey through The Dark World: Edge of Eternity, we hope you thoroughly enjoy these enhancements.

Play on and embark on epic adventures!

    Death is but the doorway to new Life

See you in game, The Digital Gods Team

notes.title: Preview of upcoming patch - The Dark World: Edge of Eternity
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/4a9abc2ee0c5ef1ee2ad6ac3589f511a59c8baf5.png

Dear players,

We would like to start this update by expressing our sincerest gratitude for your unwavering patience and support throughout the development of The Dark World: Edge of Eternity. Your feedback and enthusiasm have been invaluable in shaping the game into the best it can be, and we couldn't have come this far without you.

We are excited to share with you the latest developments and upcoming features in our next update. As always, we appreciate your continued support and feedback, and we look forward to bringing you an even better gaming experience.

In our upcoming patch, we are excited to introduce some major improvements and features that we think you'll love! We've been working hard to address player feedback and make the gameplay experience even better. Here's a sneak peek at what you can expect to see in our next update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/5e2f9a2604b768a718917df370650b72aba71b4e.png


We are excited to introduce some of the main characters to the game for the first time. These characters will mainly serve as quest givers, but some of them will also be available as companions. We can't wait for you to meet them and see how they add to the overall experience of the game.

We're excited to introduce several new features that will enhance your gameplay experience. First and foremost, we're introducing a brand new quest system that will take you on exciting adventures throughout the game world. These quests will be given to you by some of our new and important NPCs, who will serve as quest givers and sometimes even accompany you on your journeys.

In addition to the new quests, we're also implementing a new leveling system that will allow you to progress and grow your character as you play. You'll have the ability to earn skill points, which can be spent to improve your character's abilities in areas such as combat, crafting, and exploration.

We're also excited to introduce a new magic system, which will allow you to discover and learn powerful spells that can aid you in battle and exploration. And to round out the experience, we're implementing a player stats/attributes system that will help you track and improve your character's performance in various areas.

We can't wait for you to dive into these new features and see what adventures await you in The Dark World: Edge of Eternity.

New and simplified UI for better navigation and ease of use.

Basic character customization to make your character stand out in the game.

Revamped combat system for a more engaging and immersive experience.

Fishing system to enjoy the relaxing pastime and also collect food resources.

Farming system where you can cultivate crops and raise animals to generate resources and trade for goods.

Animals and breeding mechanic that allows you to collect various animals and breed them for unique offspring.

Shovel and digging mechanic to unearth treasures or dig trenches and fortifications for your base.

Improved minimap and world map for better orientation and exploration.

Enhanced swimming and diving mechanics for a more realistic and enjoyable underwater experience.

And last but not least, we're excited to announce the addition of Nvidia DLSS support for enhanced graphics and smoother gameplay on supported hardware.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/7e3656f7b082e6da0e6b6da8e6af29440209a8e8.png

We have also made significant changes to the game world by introducing three distinct territories: Human Territory, Vampire Territory, and Werewolf Territory. Each territory offers unique challenges and rewards for players, and we have balanced them to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience.

In addition, we have added a new layer of atmosphere to the game by making the Vampire Territory a snowy, winter wonderland. Players will need to adapt to the harsh climate while exploring this new area and encountering its vampire inhabitants.

We have implemented a new loot system and gameplay mechanics that will test your decision-making skills and make you think twice before taking action. Every move you make could mean the difference between life and death, and the rewards you seek may come at a great cost. Get ready to exercise your brain and weigh your options carefully, because every decision counts.

Please note that we don't have a set release date for the patch yet as we are still working on adding the final touches and making sure everything is polished and ready for release. We appreciate your patience and understanding and will keep you updated on our progress.

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to bringing you these new updates very soon. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39177857/9a9bd3c8938bfe1a83f831f9abf0917c5eff309c.png

For more information on the upcoming patch, be sure to stay updated on our website and join our Discord community. We will be sharing development updates and discussing upcoming features with our community, so be sure to follow along!

notes.title: TDW Anniversary Patch
notes.content:
Hi Survivors, 

    It’s been a year since the game came out in early access. We’ll talk about the release date of the new patch, what we’ve changed, what’s new and future plans, so stay tuned.

PATCH RELEASE DATE
    First of all, the release date of the patch. We know that we have not been active on social networks for some time, we worked on a new patch, but as the team is super small, we wanted to add as much content to the game, but we listen to you on our Discord channel, join us and give us suggestions, reviews or just talk to us. Finally.. Patch release date is 15.June.2022.

PATCH NOTES
SHORT DESCRIPTION:
    We made some mistakes at the beginning and we wanted to fix it while the game was still in its early development. The old player controller got stuck in 2018 and so we were limited to do all the fancy things that are standard in new games today. We’ve reworked the player controller from the ground up that gives us the ability to do a lot more with player animations, player movement and abilities.
    We have temporarily removed some core components that we will slowly bring back into play through the next few patches. The main reason for this is the dedicated server test and the performance of the game itself and test player vs player combat. With the new patch comes a new map into play and the new map will expand according to the new content with each patch. TDW will now receive update every 2 weeks.
   Character customization, we prepared new human player characters (male and female), and customization of player character is coming very shortly after this patch.

CHANGE LOG
MAP & ENVIRONMENT
- New map (Europe)
- Improved visual look of world objects
- Zones
- Territories of races

UI & NETWORKING
- Dedicated Servers (Windows) (Linux Servers are w.i.p) - [will be available at G-Portal on Nitrado Servers]
- Guilds 
- Party/Groups
- Chat has been reworked
- Changes related to player inventory UI
- Fixed Client is crashing on multiplayer join
- Temporarily removed Local Play (LAN)
- Fixed issue with items loading in a container
- Fixed disconnect player inventories not being remove from the server
- Fixed bodies not destroying containing inventory when destroyed
- Fixed weapon inventory’s not destroying with weapon
- Fixed quick slot not clearing when adding item to container


BASE BUILDING & CRAFTING
- Added 300+ new items 
- Added option to remove owner on plot pole
- Fixed build parts with no ground support not destroying
- Building degradation over time
- Blueprint Item has been removed from the game (all building part now need to be crafted on crafting table)
- Added learnable recipes (Crafting)
- Burnt wood now drops Charcoal Item
- New advanced spawning system for items (now we have a lot more control over spawning items)

CHARACTER & ANIMATIONS
- Fixed firing while falling
- Fixed incorrect stance changing after sprinting
- Added empty hands Punching
- Improved Melee weapons handling and animations
- New Female & Male player model and new equipment for them
- Third person aimed stance not showing crosshair
- Player now can carry 4 weapons instead of 2
- Player now can carry 10 pieces of equipment instead of 8

SOUND
- Improved weapon sounds
- Reworked environment sounds


Keep in mind that this is not a finished game and is in its early stages of development. The content shown is not final and will change or improve.
Thank you for all your support.
And remember,

Death is but the doorway to new Life

See you in game,
TDW Devs

FundRazr

We are very grateful for every your purchase, because that also really help us and motivate to work even more on that game, and also our future projects. 

Our FundRazr Page
